summary: The ProfileIcon module handles the visual representation and state management of profile and details icons within a web UI.
purpose: To manage the highlighting and state changes of profile and details icons dynamically within a GridView or Repeater control on a web page.

workflows.name: Profile Icon Highlighting
steps: Clear any highlighted profile icons back to their default state.
Identify and highlight the last-clicked profile icon by changing its CSS class.
Store the clicked icon's database ID in the ViewState for reference.

workflows.name: Details Icon Highlighting
steps: Clear any highlighted details icons back to their default state.
Identify and highlight the last-clicked details icon by changing its CSS class.
Store the clicked icon's database ID in the ViewState for reference.

system_behavior: Changes the CSS class of icons to reflect their current state (highlighted or not).
Stores the state of clicked icons in a ViewState for session persistence.
